catalog_quote: There is no distinctive tone or accent. Non-contrastive stress tends to fall on the initial syllable, with concomitant devoicing of the following syllable(s) containing voiceless onsets. The word /kʰo-pɯa/ ‘house’, for instance, is normally pronounced [kʰópɯ̥ḁ].

Quote is verbatim. Surrounding section (syllable canon (C)(C)V(C), 48 simplex onsets, 72 clusters, 8 vowels + dipht…
new_statements.rule_in_words: No contrastive tone or accent; phonetic (non-contrastive) word stress falls on the first syllable of the word, and post-tonic syllables with voiceless onsets tend to be devoiced.
new_statements.domain_note: Word level (example is a disyllabic compound noun in citation form). Statement is for the gSerpa (Gserskad, gser1237) dialect, Dgumda village variety; Sun 2023 p.348 adds that Gserskad and Rdoskad suprasegmentals are 'highly comparable' and that neither uses tone, length or nasalization contrastively, but gives no stress-placement statement for Rdoskad.
new_statements.identity_note: The quoted statement describes gSerpa Tibetan = Gserskad (Glottolog dialect gser1237, Dgumda village, Sbomda town, Serthar county, Dkarmdzes), one of the two dialect chains Glottolog unites as Gser-Rdo [gser1236]. The other chain, Rdoskad = Khalong/Khalung (rdoo1234, Dzamthang county, Rngaba), has no stress-placement statement in the open sources read; Sun 2023 p.348 says only that the two dialects' suprasegmental features are 'highly comparable' and non-tonal.

sources.note: sec. 1.2 p.110: no distinctive tone or accent; non-contrastive stress tends to fall on the initial syllable, with devoicing of following syllables with voiceless onsets (example /kʰo-pɯa/ 'house' [kʰópɯ̥ḁ]). Variety = gSerpa (Gserskad) of Dgumda village, Sbomda, Serthar county.
